threshold_basis: Project engineering targets for deciding whether to try fine-tuning; not NVIDIA requirements or a guarantee of generalization.

phases.goal: Replay the approved seed on each available isolated Isaac profile; compare reset, camera, grasp, unlock and final contact evidence before broadening.
phases.advance_when: Current runtime completes audited physical trials; failures remain recorded. An unavailable historical runtime is explicitly pending, never declared equivalent.

phases.goal: Acquire additional approved experts with genuinely different grasp or free-space paths; expand both signs gradually to the original ±30 degree requirement.
phases.candidate_start_example: 3 approved sources × 7 angles × 5 trial RNG seeds = 105 attempts; only audited numerically unique successes count.
phases.candidate_target_example: 4 approved sources × 13 angles × 4 trial RNG seeds = 208 attempts before failures or duplicates.
phases.warning: Changing RNG seeds with one source and zero motion noise does not establish new behavior or guarantee a distinct trajectory.

phases.goal: Apply and record at least four real simulator-rendered lighting/material/background variants; preserve collision geometry and the calibrated wrist mount, then repeat quality review.
phases.advance_when: Applied variant parameters and scene evidence exist, phase images decode correctly, and trajectories remain physically valid. A renamed file or declared variant alone does not count.

phases.goal: Reserve at least 20 audited unique trials derived from independent source recordings/groups and separately scheduled placements/visual settings.
phases.split_policy: Assign sources and independence groups before generation; all descendants of a group stay in one split. Never shuffle episodes from one source between candidate and holdout.
phases.advance_when: No trajectory, source recording or independence group overlaps candidate and holdout. Holdout remains untouched by later training selection.

fine_tuning_decision: Meeting these gates means the dataset is ready to discuss an initial fine-tuning experiment. Policy success and generalization still require subsequent independent closed-loop evaluation; LeRobot and GR00T export/training are intentionally deferred.
